Neon's management API: Postgres projects, branches, databases, roles and endpoints.

## API key

1. Open [neon.com](https://neon.com/docs/manage/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A project-scoped or organization API key from Settings > API keys.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add neon
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  neon: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Neon's [API](https://neon.com/docs/reference/api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show neon` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 700 a minute. About 11 a second, with bursts of 40 a second per route.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Neon).
